_about: Clips for scripts/eval_languages.py. A 'generated' clip is spoken by a macOS voice at run time. An 'own' clip is a WAV you record yourself at fixtures/clips/lang/<id>.wav (16 kHz mono); it is skipped until the file exists. 'languages' is the Settings list the pipeline is tested with, and 'speaker' is 'user' (dictation, your mic) or 'anyone' (the call). 'reference' is what was said; 'alternates' are other acceptable spellings, for example with English words in Telugu letters. The best match is scored.
